packageRules.description: Wait three days after a release before proposing it, so a hijacked or broken version is usually caught and pulled before it reaches main. Security fixes skip the wait (vulnerabilityAlerts). Longer than pnpm's own delay in pnpm-workspace.yaml, so an update Renovate merges always installs
Automerge patch and minor updates (overridden below for the packages that stay manual)
Breaking and replacement updates open a pull request, created once CI has run, for review before merging
Keep Node.js versions synchronized, reviewed as a pull request: .node-version (the home), the engines field in package.json and @types/node
Pinning and lockfile maintenance change no version anyone runs, so they always merge straight onto main once CI passes. Last, so it wins
